---
title: Low-Bandwidth Global
description: A theme for OER designed for learners in low-connectivity or under-resourced contexts.
---

**Theme ID:** `low-bandwidth-global`

## Token Defaults

```yaml
scaffolding.level: high
agency.mode: bounded-choice
feedback.mode: peer
assessment.evidence: artifact
revision.required: false
reflection.required: true
accessibility.mode: low-bandwidth
accessibility.mediaAlternatives: [transcript, printable, downloadable-assets]
bandwidth.assumption: low
localization.level: examples-localized
```

## Best For
Global OER distribution, under-resourced educational contexts, offline-capable course materials, mobile-first learning.
